messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired for service="inference-queue" (INC12345) — severity=P1 :rotating_light: queue_depth_us-west-2=12,600 (>10k threshold). Graph: https://metrics.redwood/graphs/INC12345

pagerduty: INC12345 auto-routed to rotation: maria_oncall — page delivery attempted; escalation policy: oncall->sre-lead

maria_oncall: ack INC12345 — I'm looking

maria_oncall: quick snapshot: queue depth 12.6k, inflight tokens skyrocketing, p95 latency for text generation = 1.1s, 5xx rate up to ~3% for streaming endpoints

raj_sre: +1 seeing spike in scale-controller logs. suspect warmup heartbeat didn't trigger scale for several minutes. snippet from controller logs:
```
W 10:41:32 scale-controller warmup_heartbeat_missed=true reconcile_time=1.24s path=/reconcile
W 10:42:01 autoscaler cooldown skip due to quota_check_failed
```

sam_infra: checking infra — us-west-2 GPU nodepool at 95% capacity, preemptible pool exhausted. Cloud quotas look saturated; I'm opening support ticket now

katie_prod: customers reporting 500s and timeouts on hosted API. CS pinged — some high-volume customers affected, especially batch ingestion jobs. Notified account teams.

maria_oncall: mitigation plan: 1) manual scale inference-cell; 2) temporarily loosen HPA min/max and shorten cooldown; 3) if blocked by quota, route low-priority traffic to fallback model. Executing step 1 now

maria_oncall: running: `kubectl -n inference scale deploy/inference-cell --replicas=12`

deploy-bot: action=scale deployment=inference-cell namespace=inference replicas=12 initiated by=maria_oncall

maria_oncall: patching HPA to be more aggressive (temp): minReplicas=6 maxReplicas=24 cooldown=30s

raj_sre: applying patch now:
```
kubectl patch hpa inference-cell -n inference -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":6,"maxReplicas":24}}'
```

sam_infra: cloud support case opened: 987654321 — requested emergency GPU quota bump for us-west-2. If approved, autoscaler can add nodes; otherwise we'll need to route traffic out of region.

maria_oncall: monitoring — queue depth: 12.6k -> 8.9k in 4m, p95 down to 420ms. Manual replicas are coming up.

katie_prod: starting limited rollback of last model commit on a subset of traffic to reduce per-request memory/temp usage — will flip if we see regression

sre-lead: plan B if stabilization stalls: enable fallback routing to lighter model in eu-west-1 and throttle non-critical batch jobs. @sam_infra can you confirm cross-region route readiness?

sam_infra: eu-west-1 has spare capacity; I can enable smart-routing and CORS rules. Need config PR for fallback policy and a short maintenance window commit. I'll open PR and tag @maria_oncall for approval.

maria_oncall: ack. Queue currently 4.1k -> 900 in 9m. p99 latency trending back to normal. Suspected root cause: missed warmup heartbeat combined with nodepool quota saturation preventing autoscaler from responding.

pagerduty: INC12345 acknowledged by maria_oncall

maria_oncall: leaving incident notes in tracker: https://incidents.redwood/INC12345 — handoff plan: I'll monitor for 30m and then hand off to @sre-lead if still active. If queue spikes again, escalate to infra lead and execs.

katie_prod: confirmed customer-facing metrics improving; informing CS to lift urgent outreach.

maria_oncall: closing active mitigation for now — queue <1k and endpoints stable. Will update postmortem template and include warmup heartbeat checks + quota watch. :white_check_mark:
